title: FOUNDATION MODEL OF ELECTRONIC MEDICAL RECORDS FOR ADAPTIVE RISK ESTIMATION

bias_targets.methodology: Stratifying predictive performance (AUROC) for clinical risk tasks (e.g., mortality, ICU admission) across male and female patient subgroups to assess potential disparities in model accuracy.

Stratifying predictive performance (AUROC) for clinical risk tasks across various racial and ethnic subgroups (Asian, Black, Hispanic, White, Other, Unknown) to evaluate robustness and potential disparities in predictive accuracy.
